```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The state of the economy has dominated headlines for months, and the news has not been good.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The sub-prime lending debacle has sent the housing market into a tailspin.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many Americans have lost their homes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"By early August, the economy had shed 463,000 jobs over seven straight months of job loss.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health, gas and food prices are rising dramatically.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Families have seen their incomes go down even as they have been working longer hours and as productivity has grown.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Companies have shed health insurance coverage and pensions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Too many Americans have lost confidence in the fundamental American promise that their children will have a better life than they do.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The world is living through an age of fundamental economic transformation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Technology has changed the way people live and the way the world does business.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The collapse of the Soviet Union and the advance of capitalism have vanquished old challenges to America's global leadership.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"New challenges to America's global leadership have emerged.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Jobs and industries can move to any country with an Internet connection and willing workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
